reviews.review: Got this for me and my wife for Christmas, since we really loved playing L4D2 together, but wanted something new to play together. Anacrusis absolutely delivers in that department. It's basically L4D2 but more. The visuals might be a bit too bright and colourful for some, but they worked really well for us and we love the art style of the environment and characters. The aliens are easy enough to recognise and the difficulty curve feels just right. We'll be returning to this one for months on end for sure.

The group I game with has been looking for something that fit the vibe of L4D and L4D2, but Back 4 Blood wasn't scratching the itch. In comes The Anacrusis. This game scratches the itch well! It truly feels like playing Left 4 Dead for the first time again. This isn't a straight clone though. There's fun new specials and the perks system is passive and adds a fun twist to the game.

I read/watched the IGN video review and decided to take a chance in lieu of their poor rating and let me tell you... they are out of touch. This game is great and at 50% off it's a steal! I would have absolutely paid $30 or $40 for this.

A tidy co-op shooter with some fun ideas and a delightfully weird world, The Anacrusis has a small community but a dedicated one.  Movement is crisp and smooth, and while there isn't a tremendous diversity of guns there are a bunch of ways to improve them.  AI teammates are surprisingly competent if you play alone, and if you want to play with people join the Discord.  As a bonus: the devs continue to work on the game, adding modes and improvements.  And there are mods!
The game is cool but L4D2 is better. I love conversation pits.

Okay fellas. Analogy time.

Left 4 Dead is a pristine clean toilet.
Vermintide/Darktide is a 3-star hotel toilet (it's pretty clean it's just slightly soaked with pee)
Back 4 Blood is a porta-potty at a county fair that's seen quite a bit of use.
The Anacrusis is a hole in the ground in a third world country.

This is how i'd describe the culture and development used in any of these 4 player co-op horde shooters and the Anacrusis is the worst of the bunch by far. Weapons do not feel good, the missions are repetitve and uninsipired, and Chet's wife is marginally hot.

I also got the game for 40 cents from CD Keys so don't buy it on here.

This ends my review.

I am a 45 yo father, probably one of the oldest people playing this game. I am a single father to my Son, who is 14 now. My son got this game for Christmas in 2023 from his uncle, so we installed it on his computer and he started playing. By the end of the week he had 24 hours on this game. This was horrible for me, as it was already hard for me to find ways to spend time with my son, as he is always out with his friends or just watching YouTube. So i decided to make a Steam account and get this game to see if I could maybe play alongside him. I loaded into the game, picked my character and world and started playing but I was stuck on what you where supposed to do. I asked my Son for help and he hosted a game for me to join. I loved it as it was the best time I had spent with my Son since my wife had died. This game has ever since brought me and my son closer again and now we actually spend time together outside the house together as well. This game reminded me that there's fun to be had in everything, and it has brought both me and my Son many happy memories.

Wait for updates.
